mechanism: Chlorthalidone-induced hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia increase risk of QT prolongation, which is also a known adverse effect of fluoroquinolones, creating additive cardiac risk.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium and magnesium) before and during concurrent use; consider alternative diuretic or ensure electrolyte supplementation; obtain baseline and follow-up ECGs if QT prolongation risk factors present.
